scores.tell: Inflated toy-plastic forms: puffy pillow deck body and swollen headphones in uniform glossy plastic, all hues at full chroma, too round like the barrel lesson
Slightly wide-angle flare on the legs and a hero that sits a bit small over a big empty peach floor band; metal legs a touch uniformly chrome
Bulbous plush-toy cat with oversized head and airbrushed velvet fur, same root problem as the grade-1 cat lesson, only matte instead of glossy
Ball tips slightly large and gem a bit hot; otherwise clean faceted icon on a sunburst that matches the real cards
Light beam is a smeared, ghosted rainbow blur with no clean shape; the hero is hard to read at thumbnail size
Flat head-on, near-orthographic view with a low camera, small doors in a lot of empty teal; the posts and caps are chunky
Mask glass is a vague milky translucent smear, and the deck planks and water ripples are slightly busy and textured
Lens glint slightly hard and neon blue; tripod legs flare a little wide; otherwise reads as real
Trunk built from stacked fat rings and thick rubbery fronds give a toy look; pure magenta and neon green with no neutral
Stone has a painterly marble smudge and soft checker top; hero is a little small in a busy park scene, but layering matches the real swing card
